note: Reports from the International Congress of Mathematicians in Philadelphia on how mathematicians are reacting to AI, centred on Terence Tao's lecture on a crisis in mathematical values and practices. It includes views from Ravi Vakil, Jacob Tsimerman, Michael Harris, early-career researchers and critics of AI use in mathematics.
title: If AI can do math, what’s the point of mathematicians? (also headed “AI has finally come for math—mathematicians might never recover”)
